SELECT cas_number, name, location, max_quantity, representative_lot_id FROM (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        name,
        location,
        MAX(quantity) as max_quantity,
        (SELECT lot_id FROM reagents r2 WHERE r2.cas_number = r1.cas_number AND r2.quantity = r1.quantity ORDER BY lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) as representative_lot_id
    FROM reagents r1
    GROUP BY cas_number, name, location, MAX(quantity)
) ORDER BY cas_number;

args.query:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        lot_id, cas_number, name, quantity, location, notes,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cas_number ORDER BY quantity DESC, lot_id DESC) as rnk
    FROM reagents
)
SELECT cas_number, name, location, quantity, lot_id, notes 
FROM ranked 
WHERE rnk = 1 
ORDER BY cas_number;
